SELECT
  COALESCE(pmt.payment_type, 'unknown') AS payment_type,
  ABS(SUM(pmt.payment_value)) AS total_payment,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(ABS(pmt.payment_value)) OVER () = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ABS(SUM(pmt.payment_value)) * 100.0 / SUM(ABS(pmt.payment_value)) OVER ()
  END AS percentage_of_total
FROM
  order_payments pmt
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(pmt.payment_type, 'unknown')
ORDER BY
  total_payment DESC;
